name: Blue Scribes

bonuses.name: Disc Riders
bonuses.text: The Blue Scribes can make one Sharp quills attack, one Blades attack, and one Sorcerous Barrage each turn.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this threat must make a DN 4 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Sorcerous Barrage
abilities.text: The Blue Scribes attempt to activate a psychic power including Smite or a Maleficarum psychic power, treat Corruption as 5.
The Blue Scribes turn on one another, and return to the Warp, squabbling amongst themselves.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 5d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Speed printed '12(Flying)'. Keyword PSKYER printed as such (likely PSYKER).
